body_markdown:
Sambit Srimany, from our Marine Team, recently joined a Riviera Maritime Media webinar discussing the implementation of the IMO Resolution MSC.581(110 **)** and its impact on enclosed space entry procedures across the maritime industry.


Representing Hafnia, Sambit Srimany participated in a panel discussion alongside industry experts and regulatory representatives. The session explored the practical implications of the updated requirements, sharing perspectives on compliance, operational implementation and safety best practices.


A link to the full recording can be viewed with registration here: https://events.rivieramm.com/attendee-login/login
